body: Hm, I don't think we have a util to convert a `org.jboss.jandex.Type` to something that could be passed as a recorder param. But maybe we will not need this. @radcortez how are the indexed properties handled in SR config? Are clients supposed to call  `org.eclipse.microprofile.config.Config.getValues(String, Class<T>)` or?

It should work. The injection of indexed properties is handled by SR `ConfigProducerUtil`. This was added in https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/commit/820baaa346c9021987f74af26428de500ccc7019 and we added a bunch of tests for injection points. 

Let me try the reported use case.
The problem in this case is not in SR Config. It's in Quarkus only when we perform the validation logic (which does not know about the parameterized type)

Ok, it seems I added a https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/820baaa346c9021987f74af26428de500ccc7019/extensions/arc/deployment/src/test/java/io/quarkus/arc/test/config/IndexedPropertiesInjectionTest.java#L52 to the test :D

Yes, if we remove the validation logic it works as expected. 

@mkouba what was your idea?

> Yes, if we remove the validation logic it works as expected.
> 

Yup. The fix is rather easy, as long as we record the signature of a type at build time and use it at runtime to obtain a parameterized type.
If we do that, and take this type into account, everything will just work.
My question to @mkouba was which existing pieces should we just to do that?

Understood, thanks!

Indeed just passing the component type of the collection type would be enough in this case
I can fix it this week. `2.0.1.Final` is already out, so it doesn't make sense to try and get it in as fast as possible. But I do want it in for when `2.0.2.Final` so I'll take a look soon
